thread:
kai: ran the longctx RoPE sweep overnight across llama-34b / mixtral-45 / qwen-70b. saw a reproducible perf cliff for NTK variants on qwen when prefix > ~50k. attaching quick notes.

tess: saw the same in the rolling profiler. kernel_picker kept picking matmul_opt until eviction kicked in -> big KV write bursts.

omar: can you paste the flame result? curious about head/fallback distribution.

kai: paste below (excerpts):
```
KV.write  58%  (bursts at 52k..55k)
matmul_opt  20%
head_slice_fallback  12%  (higher for 64-head configs)
other_misc  10%
```

rahul: interesting signal. my theory: NTK RoPE pushes effective angle scaling so that the reuse window changes; continuous-batcher keeps growing micro-batches, delaying early head-slicing and causing large KV churn.

tess: we also observed elevated KV.write_latency_p50 and KV.miss_rate correlated with the cliff. both spike before ppl rises.

kai: repro command I used locally: 
```
./sweep_runner --model qwen-70b --rope ntk --max-prefix 60000 --batch-mode continuous \
  --kernel-policy dynamic --out /tmp/qwen_ntk_60k.json
```

omar: tried a quick head-slice shift (head_dim 128->96) on mixtral45 and it shaved ~7% off fallback_gemm time, no ppl regression on our short eval. worth trying as a guarded knob.

rahul: propose mitigations:
- introduce a soft KV-write-rate throttle in the continuous batcher (default 40k/sec)
- make kernel_picker prefer head_slice_fallback earlier for qwen-like dims when prefix > threshold
- add per-model safe_prefix metadata: example: qwen-70b: {linear: 64k, ntk: 48k, yarn: 56k} (draft)

tess: +1 on per-model metadata. we should surface it to the console so customers see recommended longctx limits.

kai: plan: A/B test two changes in canary: (A) batcher throttle, (B) earlier head-slice preference. measure ppl, hallucination_count, KV.miss_rate.

omar: running A/B now. local cmd: 
```
./canary_run --model qwen-70b --variant ab --changes throttle,headslice --prefixsweep 32k,48k,64k --out results/ab_qwen_ntk.json
```

perf-bot: [auto] perf job created: ropesweep-qwen-ab-1719997777 -> https://perf.redwood/boards/ropesweep/tx-1719997777

jess: quick note: eu hosts running older kernels; region variance might mask results. recommend region pinning for the canary.

rahul: noted. also adding a simple regression gate: fail canary if ppl delta > 0.35 or hallucination score increases by >5%.

ci-bot: created task INF-905: "qwen longctx ntk canary + safe-prefix metadata" assigned to omar/rahul/kai

kai: action items:
- omar: drop A/B outputs to perf board and attach flamegraphs (EOD)
- rahul: draft per-model safe_prefix table for Llama/Mistral/Mixtral/Qwen (include head/kv dims)
- tess: implement soft batcher throttle toggle in canary config
- jess: coordinate region pinning for eu hosts

omar: starting run now, will ping on completion.
